verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies Blaster Stream as a Ki Blast Ultimate costing 300 Ki, with beam, long-range, chargeable, 1-35 hit, and knockback characteristics.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Blaster Stream is a skill reward from Parallel Quest 148 — Finding Out About Fusion. Independent PQ documentation lists Blaster Stream among the three skill rewards for PQ148.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the reviewed sources establish the PQ reward route but do not provide explicit evidence sufficient to assert an Ultimate Finish requirement.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Blaster Stream is kept distinct from Blaster Cannon, Blaster Bomb, Crush Stream, and other similarly named Kale/Kefla skills.
verification_audit.damage_policy: Exact damage percentages are not promoted as canonical database values because observed damage can depend on character stats and version conditions.

records.name: Blaster Stream
records.character_source: Kale (Super Saiyan 2); Kefla (Super Saiyan) - Customize Partner
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 148 — Finding Out About Fusion
records.skill_description: Unleash a powerful Ki Wave; charging increases the charge level and damage, and a successful hit can be followed by a stronger Ki Wave.
records.mechanics_notes: The user charges a beam between their hands and fires it in a straight line. If the initial beam connects, a second stronger Ki Wave follows. Charging increases damage and the number of hits; the fully charged version requires a hard knockdown or stamina break to land reliably.
